## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [12. Mai 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.126
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.126
- Datum: 12.5.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 4 Scans

pages.transcription:
Hotel Wyndham 42 West 58 Street New York		12. V 1941
Dear Hannah and Manfred, we have just your letter from the
2 May, mail is now much quicker and this we take as a good
sign - There are still things like Hess' flight out of Germany which
let us hope that in the Nasi-Empire not all is so perfect as they like
to let us believe. You in London and England have to share the
bitterest part but I hope you have the conscience that your sufferings
and your courage can and will alone save this world. We follow
on the radio and in the newspapers anxiously the events and I must
not tell you that all our thoughts are with you. I wish Manfred
could finish his examinations soon and have some rest! You
too would feel much better - your nerves must be wrely shared[?]
by his dentist-treatment. I know how one feels during such a
treatment, how one hates his own head, his whole body. May the
thought you be helpful that Eva enjoys her life at Croton very
much and that she really is in best hands; Mr. Schaeffer did
win her full confidence and love and as she is really interested
in her progress you can expect the best results. We will visit her
very soon - this week is rather up with a hundred things. My
speech had to be cut from 10 minutes to 6, I have to speak in
German and in English for the European radio transmission. You
cannot imagine what pettiness authors develop on such occasions,
everybody is offended, one because he got only 2 minutes, the
other because he has not to sit on the parade-table, the third be-
cause one had not invited him personally - they cannot under-
stand people like Lotte and me who would be happy not so sit
for show and prefer to leave to them all these little things that
seem so ridiculous in a time where horses are smashed, inno-
cent people murdered and the greatest decision of mankind is
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf Hotelpapier. Die Tinte ist violett. Die Lesbarkeit ist gut, abgesehen von dem Wort 'wrely shared' (evtl. 'sorely shared' oder 'sorely shaken'?).

pages.transcription:
at stake. Sometimes one wonders that those are the same people
who really wrote beautiful verses and show in her books wisdom
and psychology.
I did not cable to you about Joaquim Torres. I liked to
leave it to you; it is not important to care about him, one
will never hear from him again, but if you thought it better
to acknowledge his letter you may do it. - Lotte is here still in
treatment for some weeks but only twice a week and we hope
it will be effectif. She feels much better and we hope to go for
two months somewhere to the country not only on behalf of the
heat in New York but also because one looses so much time here.
We see not many people but very interesting ones and make
no public appearance whatever except on this one dinner. Most
of my collegues are in California, from English writers there live
here Somerset Maugham, Cronin, Bertrand Russel, Auden,
some of them for good. I have an invitation for lectures
in Cuba in November - the voyage paid and even
a good fee for lectures - but who can say if it will be
possible to Cuba at this date? The most important for us is
to know you both at Bath and to have a rest; we feel our-
selves not very important in whatever we do and you must
never worry about us or Eva. Altogether it seems as in the
long run the turn will come, the preparations here in
America are accelerated from day to day for the necessary
relief of your burden! Kindest regards to you all! Yours
Stefan Zweig
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief, Fortsetzung der ersten Seite. Violette Tinte.
Rückseite des Dokuments, zeigt den durchscheinenden Text der Vorderseite (bleed-through). Leer.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar, die Handschrift von Stefan Zweig ist bekannt und klar. Einzelne Wörter wie 'wrely' sind aufgrund der Schreibweise leicht unsicher, aber im Kontext verständlich.
